text:
rachel: Drafted a new compact onboarding banner that sits above the workspace list. Intention: single-line prompt + two actions (Create workspace / Try sample). Fig: https://figma.com/file/newbanner | want quick eyes on copy, density, and a11y.

diego: Liking the single-line approach. Copy idea: 'Welcome! Create a workspace or try a sample in 2 mins.' Might be long; maybe split.

zoe: Split would read cleaner. Primary: 'Create workspace' (explicit). Secondary: 'Try sample — 2 min' (sets expectation).

rachel: Note: primary creates starter content but no billing. Should we surface "no billing" in microcopy?

diego: Yes, anxiety reduction is good. Maybe tiny subcopy under primary: 'Starter workspace, no billing required'. Keep it visually subtle.

zoe: Accessibility: contrast on the subtle subcopy fails at small sizes. Recommend bump font to 13px or darken by 10%. Also ensure banner is skip-friendly: add a skip-to-main link.

a11y-bot: Automated checks: primary (#0c63ff on white) = 5.4:1 pass at 14px. Subcopy (#6fa7ff on white) = 3.4:1 fail. Action: use #3b78d6 or increase weight. Also missing aria-label on secondary if it's icon+text compacted.

rachel: Good catches. UX question: should sample tiles be inline under banner or in a modal? Inline keeps users on page, modal reduces nav friction. Thoughts?

diego: Inline is better for discoverability; modal is fine for focus. Maybe open sample details in a modal but keep the sample card inline with clear CTA.

zoe: For keyboard flow, ensure banner actions come before workspace tiles. Also add aria-live polite when sample starts.

a11y-bot: Live region note: no live region currently. Recommend role="status" on a hidden region for announcing 'Sample started'.

rachel: Plan: 1) change subcopy color to #3b78d6, 2) primary label 'Create workspace', 3) secondary 'Try sample — 2 min' with aria-label 'Try sample: chat demo, 2 minutes', 4) keep samples inline + modal details, 5) add aria-live status. I'll update figma and post a PR.

diego: Nice. Also add data-attributes for analytics: data-cta for both.

zoe: Quick nit: make sure touch target for secondary icon+text stays >=44px on small widths.

rachel: Yep will enforce min-height. Thanks all, will ping with PR link.
